# Draft:Anduril Industries operations in the United Kingdom

Anduril Industries operations in the United Kingdom refers to the activities of the American defence technology company Anduril Industries within the United Kingdom. These include border surveillance systems deployed for the Home Office, defence contracts with the Ministry of Defence,  and partnerships with UK aerospace and technology organisations.
Border surveillance deployments
The company's activities have primarily been associated with technology supplied to the Home Office for monitoring activity in the English Channel, particularly along the south-east coast of England. Between 22 June 2022 and 22 June 2025 the Home Office had a contract with Anduril titled CCTC – Common Operating Picture and Command Interface (COPCI), valued at £16,087,370. As of the contract's renewal, it is valued at £21,086,291.
As part of this contract, at least ten Anduril Maritime Sentry Towers, 5.5-metre-tall towers towers fitted with radar as well as thermal and electro-optical imaging sensors have been identified between Hastings and Ramsgate. According to the company, the Sentry system is an autonomous surveillance platform designed to detect and track objects using artificial intelligence.
Government contracts
The Ministry of Defence (United Kingdom) has awarded contracts involving Anduril technologies, including a £30 million programme to supply Altius loitering munitions systems for use by Ukraine through UK procurement initiatives.
Defence and technology partnerships
Anduril has collaborated with several aerospace and technology organisations in the United Kingdom. In 2025 the company led a consortium with Archer Aviation, Skyports Drone Services, and AtkinsRéalis to explore dual-use electric vertical take-off and landing (eVTOL) aircraft applications in the UK. The initiative aims to evaluate civil and defence uses of Archer’s Midnight aircraft, including logistics operations and beyond-visual-line-of-sight drone missions.
